## Summary
<!-- One to three sentences: what the change does and which problem in the repository it addresses. -->

## Changes
<!-- Bullets of what changed, grouped by file or area. -->

## Behaviour changes
<!-- Anything a caller or operator must know: response fields, defaults, permissions, dependencies. Write None if there are none. -->

## Verification
<!-- What was actually run and its result, and also what was not verified and why (for example, tests that only run in CI, or no deployment to check against). -->

## Related
<!-- SPEC/ADR ids and related pull requests as khala-labs/<repo>#<n>. Leave the section out if there is nothing. -->

<!--
Never in a description:
- The decision process: who chose what, what is still undecided, review opinions from conversations. Decisions live in SPECs, ADRs or OPEN.md; the description cites their id.
- Assessments of the project or its weaknesses that the change does not address. Those become OPEN.md items.
- Tooling and session detail: which drafting tool, assistant or agent wrote text, local scratch paths, reviewer model names.
- Organization, person, partner or external project names, and real page ids (the fingerprint scan checks part of this; it is not exhaustive).
- Numbers without meaning; counts belong in Verification as results.
-->
